subject: Polymorphism
notes: Rule 9.3.5.3 item 2 'The expected calling convention' and its consumer 9.3.6 match rule 2 (cite.py OK 9.3.6 2) 'The same calling convention shall be in effect for the invocation as is in effect for the invoked method'). The METHOD side is constant: ENTRY-CONVENTION admits only COBOL (entry-convention-name-1 is COBOL2385, DOC-A.1-64). The INVOCATION side is now constant too: >>CALL-CONVENTION admits only COBOL (any other word is COBOL1911), so the component cannot differ between an invocation and a method and the name-only signature is exactly equivalent to one that includes it. LANDED w1007b (kb/Work PB1383): WiseOwl COBOL defines no call-convention-name, as docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-68 states, so the directive row's operand set is COBOL alone (constructs.json call-convention-directive-2002; the 'any COBOL word' userWord column is deleted): >>CALL-CONVENTION XYZZY is COBOL1911 (conformance:cases/7.3.9-CALL-CONVENTION/pb1383-call-convention-undefined-name), and >>CALL-CONVENTION COBOL + CALL "p1383s" reaches P1383S by the case-insensitive COBOL-word mapping (conformance:cases/7.3.9-CALL-CONVENTION/pb1383_call_convention_cobol).
